description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Pokunuwita, Horana D/S Division, Kalutara District (25/0069)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registrations, property ownership determinations, and land parcel adjudications under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels with owner information, property boundaries, and title classifications, which falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
